Nine Of "More Than Twenty" Aussie Cops Tested Failed "Drug Tests"
According To Swedish Prohibitionists 

Press release:

April 6 1999

Nine Australian police officers tested positive for drugs

A new drug program undertaken in the state of New South Wales has led to the detection of drugs in the blood of nine police officers. Cocaine, amphetamines, ecstasy and marijuana were recorded in drug tests on the targeted officers, who now face dismissal.

More than 20 police officers have been tested under the programme under way for just three months and two officers have already quit the service after receiving the test results.
